title: Pony Land
specs: Only beach in San Diego where you can ride a horse
Guided rides through nature preserve with wildlife and ocean views
Trail riders must be at least 6 years old
Children 9 and under are on lead line for trail rides
Minimum age for hand led pony rides is 2 years
Children under 10 years old must wear helmet; optional otherwise
Weight limit for regular horse is 220 pounds; max 265 pounds with height requirements and additional $15/hr for draft horse
Parties of 6 or more require non-refundable deposit of half the amount
Can accommodate any size party and any type of event
$3 charge per person over 20 guests for parties

blurb: Guests can enjoy guided trail and beach horseback rides, pony rides for young children, and visit a petting zoo. The ranch offers party packages with pony rides, petting zoo time, and other activities. They also provide horse and wagon rentals for events and summer camps for children to learn horsemanship.
